svg.title: GOSSIP AND FAILURE DETECTION: sketchnote
svg.text: Who is alive, with no central server, when silence can
One random ping per interval; indirect probes through other
nodes before suspicion; a grace period to refute.
Tell a few random peers each round: news reaches N nodes in
~log N rounds with constant work per node.
Short: fast detection, false alarms in GC
Long: requests keep going to dead nodes
Phi accrual: suspicion level from heartbeat
Cheap actions at low suspicion, data
Never elect leaders or take locks by gossip:
"Nodes gossip membership every second, so news
reaches 500 nodes in about 9 rounds. Phi accrual
stops routing reads to a suspect node quickly,
but re-replication waits minutes, so a GC pause
